title: Journalist & Whistleblower Privacy Policy Template
metaDescription: Professional privacy policy template for journalists and news organizations to protect sources and ensure secure communications.
description: A comprehensive privacy policy template specifically designed for journalists, news organizations, and whistleblower platforms. Covers source protection, secure communication protocols, and data handling practices essential for press freedom.

sections.heading: Information Collection and Source Protection
sections.content:
We are committed to protecting the identity and safety of our sources. We collect information only when necessary for journalistic purposes and implement the following protections:

• Source identities are kept confidential and stored separately from story content
• We use secure communication channels including encrypted messaging and SecureDrop
• Personal information is minimized and anonymized whenever possible
• We do not collect unnecessary metadata that could compromise source identity
• All staff are trained in digital security practices and source protection protocols

sections.heading: Secure Communication Practices
sections.content:
To ensure the safety of our sources and the integrity of our reporting, we employ multiple layers of security:

• All communications with sources use end-to-end encryption
• We provide SecureDrop instances for anonymous document submission
• Staff use privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser for sensitive research
• VPN connections are required when accessing source materials
• Regular security audits ensure our systems remain secure
• Physical documents are stored in secure, access-controlled environments

sections.heading: Data Storage and Retention
sections.content:
We handle sensitive information with the highest security standards:

• Source-identifying information is stored on air-gapped, encrypted systems
• Data retention periods are minimized to reduce exposure risk
• Automatic deletion protocols remove sensitive data after [RETENTION_PERIOD]
• Backups are encrypted and stored in secure, geographically distributed locations
• Access to sensitive data is restricted to essential personnel only
• We maintain detailed access logs for security auditing purposes

sections.heading: Legal Protections and Disclosure Policies
sections.content:
We are committed to protecting our sources through all available legal means:

• We invoke shield laws and reporter's privilege to protect source confidentiality
• Legal challenges to information requests are fought vigorously
• Sources are immediately notified of any legal threats when safely possible
• We maintain relationships with press freedom attorneys
• Warrant canaries and transparency reports are published regularly
• International sources receive additional protections under applicable laws

sections.heading: Third-Party Services and Vendors
sections.content:
When working with external services, we ensure they meet our security standards:

• All vendors undergo security assessments before engagement
• Data processing agreements include strict confidentiality requirements
• Cloud services are vetted for jurisdiction and privacy protections
• We avoid services that could compromise source safety or story integrity
• Regular audits ensure third-party compliance with our security standards
• Alternative, privacy-focused services are prioritized when available

sections.heading: Incident Response and Breach Notification
sections.content:
In the event of a security incident, we follow established protocols:

• Immediate assessment and containment of any security breach
• Affected sources are notified through secure channels when safe to do so
• Law enforcement cooperation is balanced against source protection obligations
• Public disclosure follows transparency principles while protecting ongoing investigations
• Post-incident reviews improve our security practices
• Independent security audits may be conducted following significant incidents

sections.heading: Contact and Security Information
sections.content:
For secure communication with our newsroom:

• SecureDrop: [SECUREDROP_URL]
• Encrypted email: [ENCRYPTED_EMAIL]
• Signal: [SIGNAL_NUMBER]
• Physical mail: [SECURE_MAILING_ADDRESS]
• PGP keys are available at: [PGP_KEY_LOCATION]

This privacy policy is reviewed annually and updated as needed to reflect current best practices in journalist and source protection.

useCases: News organizations establishing source protection policies
Media outlets complying with press freedom standards
Investigative journalism teams implementing security protocols
